unit: basic request per month (no JavaScript rendering, standard proxies)

vendors.name: ScraperAPI
vendors.note: A standard page costs 1 credit; Amazon, Google, LinkedIn and bot-protected sites cost more. render=true costs 10 credits. Professional and Advanced carry limited-offer bonus-credit labels; the page does not say whether the totals include them.

vendors.name: ScrapingBee
vendors.note: Credits counted at the 1-credit classic-proxy rate without rendering, which requires render_js=false; JavaScript rendering is on by default at 5 credits. Larger plans exist on the vendor page and are not modeled here.

vendors.name: Scrapfly
vendors.note: A basic request costs 1 credit; residential proxies and browser rendering cost more, and bandwidth above 1MB on large responses is billed separately. Discovery hard-caps at quota and is treated as capped, although the table also shows $5.00 per 10,000 for it. Pro and above switch to pay-as-you-go; the billing docs (https://scrapfly.io/docs/billing) cap extra usage at 50% of monthly quota on non-custom plans, then suspend the account until renewal or upgrade, so overage is limited to 50% of included credits here. Custom plans from $1,200/mo and signup credits are not modeled.

vendors.name: ScrapingDog
vendors.note: Credits counted at the 1-credit rate, which requires dynamic=false; JavaScript rendering is on by default at 5 credits. Larger plans exist on the vendor page and are not modeled here. The free plan is not modeled.
